articles.summary: 24/7 Wall St.: Nio, Li Auto, and Xpeng Climb on Record March Deliveries as Tesla Faces a Softer Q1. Shares of Nio (NYSE:NIO), Li Auto (NASDAQ:LI), and Xpeng (NYSE:XPEV) are all trading higher Wednesday morning after each posted March delivery figures, while Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) ticks up modestly ahead of its own Q1 report.
